tasks.title: Inventory generator output paths and write modes
tasks.prompt:
Build an inventory of what the repo's generators write. Scope it to at most 25 scripts: run `ls scripts/generate-*.mjs`, and if there are more than 25, take the first 25 alphabetically and say so in the report.

This is an inventory pass, not a deep analysis. For each script, skim it for its write calls (writeFile, writeFileSync, outputFile, cp, rename) and record:
  - Script name
  - Output path(s) it writes, as literals where the code gives literals; if a path is built at runtime, record the expression rather than guessing the result
  - Write mode: WHOLE-FILE if it serializes a freshly built string over the whole file, MERGE if it reads the existing file and edits regions or fields, UNCLEAR if the code does not plainly say
  - The file:line of the write call

Do not attempt cross-generator collision analysis and do not rank risk; a later pass does that. Accuracy and coverage of these four columns is the whole job.

Write the inventory to night-shift/audits/generator-write-inventory.md as a markdown table with those columns, sorted by script name, preceded by one line stating how many scripts exist and how many this pass covered. Record only what the code shows; mark anything you could not determine as UNCLEAR rather than inferring it.

Write exactly one file: night-shift/audits/generator-write-inventory.md. Change no other file.
